scope: Explicit standalone NTFS read with actual caller ACL checks, not an authenticated Windows/Linux product bridge
implemented: Closed bounded seven-field unsigned enrollment and purpose-separated review/confirmation binding actual Windows SID, exact root/relative path, byte limit and expected SHA256
Actual non-elevated interactive primary token, no active impersonation or enabled debug/backup/restore/ownership bypass privileges; repeated token identity checks
Ordinary-caller kernel access plus repeated AccessCheck against current handle DACLs, including while an existing read handle remains open
Pinned ancestors/source with write/delete sharing refused, exact NTFS file identity and canonical final path, metadata-first no-recall/no-reparse opens
No namespace enumeration, writes or hydration authority; device/traversal/ADS/aliases/reparse/hardlink/offline/observed-placeholder refusal
Combined component count checked before source handles open, source maximum1MiB, enrollment8192bytes, repeated complete32KiB-block reads and exact expected hash before returning hex
Bounded enrollment-file capture uses the same real-token, pinned-handle and ACL checks; input remains inert and unsigned
cross_review: Replaced race-prone control-file pathname reads with the same bounded ordinary-caller pinned-handle capture
Inspect metadata and ACL before acquiring data/list access; request OPEN_NO_RECALL and OPEN_REPARSE_POINT without claiming universal cloud-provider qualification
Enforce combined path-component bounds before opening any source handles
Production code has no test hook; a test-only reflection helper revokes the ACL of an owned fixture under its real live lease and requires exact UnauthorizedAccessException
Fixture ACL restoration explicitly marks the DACL modified and proves that the same live lease/read succeeds after restore; no naive unmodified security snapshot is treated as restored

execution.security_fixtures: Tiny disposable NTFS GUID child of repository .luma; sparse overlength metadata fixture

limits: Synchronous kernel opens, metadata operations, storage/filter drivers and disposal are not covered by a hard process deadline
Cloud no-hydration behavior, two-user isolation and declared platform tuples still need actual qualification
Stable ancestor identity/write times are conservatively required; unrelated namespace changes can refuse without automatic retry
Returned bytes are untrusted data; neither unsigned enrollment nor confirmation is managed custody, a product grant or an authenticated guest identity
Stdout can deliver a prefix if the process or consumer stops; this is not a finite product export session
remaining_development: Signed companion and qualified verifier dependencies/custody/time/revocation delivery
Authenticated SID/principal IPC bridge, persistent enrollment and finite product grants
Populated runnable WSL rootfs, safe install/update/rollback and hosted lifecycle
Effective confinement/resources, real compact inference and separate complete Hyper-V desktop proof
